providers.title: Snapper's polynomial
providers.scope: For coherent F on a proper k-scheme and invertible L_1, ..., L_r, chi(F tensor L_1^n_1 ... L_r^n_r) is a polynomial of total degree at most dim Supp F.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Rules for intersection numbers
providers.scope: Intersection numbers are integers, symmetric and multilinear, vanish on sheaves of smaller dimension, are additive, and equal the sum over top-dimensional components weighted by generic lengths.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Restriction to a divisor
providers.scope: For a section s of L_1 on V that is injective on O_V, (L_1 L_2 ... L_d . V) = (L_2 ... L_d . D), D the zero scheme of s.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Degrees on curves
providers.scope: On an integral curve, (L . C) = chi(L|C) - chi(O_C), and it equals the length of the zero scheme of any nonzero section; in particular it is nonnegative if L|C has a nonzero section.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Pullback of intersection numbers
providers.scope: (f^*L_1 ... f^*L_d . W) = [k(W):k(f(W))] (L_1 ... L_d . f(W)) if dim f(W) = dim W, and 0 otherwise.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Zeros and poles on a curve
providers.scope: A nonzero rational function on a normal integral proper curve has as many zeros as poles, with multiplicity; a nonconstant one has at least one zero and one pole.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Positivity of ample bundles
providers.scope: (L^d . Z) > 0 for L ample and every closed subscheme Z of dimension d.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Hyperplane sections
providers.scope: For H very ample and V integral of dimension d, (H . L_2 ... L_d . V) is a positive integer combination of intersection numbers on integral subvarieties of dimension d - 1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Globally generated and positive on curves
providers.scope: A globally generated invertible sheaf on a proper k-scheme with positive degree on every curve is ample.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The Nakai-Moishezon criterion
providers.scope: On a projective scheme over an algebraically closed field, L is ample if and only if (L^dim V . V) > 0 for every integral closed subscheme V of positive dimension.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Kleiman's theorem
providers.scope: If L is nef and A ample on a projective scheme, then (L^i . A^(d-i) . V) >= 0 for every integral V of dimension d; in particular (L^d . V) >= 0.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Nef plus ample is ample
providers.scope: If L is nef and A ample, then aL + bA is ample for all integers a >= 0, b >= 1.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Rational combinations
providers.scope: If cL = aN + bM with N nef, M ample and positive integers a, b, c, then L is ample.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Macaulay's theorem
providers.scope: If the leading forms of f_1, ..., f_n in F[x_1, ..., x_n] have no common nontrivial zero, then dim F[x]/(f) = deg f_1 ... deg f_n.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Isolated zeros in a deformation
providers.scope: At an isolated zero P of the special fibre of a one-parameter deformation of n equations, the completed local algebra is free of rank mu_P over k[[t]].
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Bézout's inequality
providers.scope: For g_1, ..., g_n in k[x_1, ..., x_n] with deg g_i <= d_i (k algebraically closed), the multiplicities of the isolated zeros add up to at most d_1 ... d_n.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Weighted Bézout inequality
providers.scope: In characteristic zero, for polynomials of weighted degree at most N with weights rho_1, ..., rho_n, the multiplicities of the isolated zeros add up to at most N^n/(rho_1 ... rho_n).
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
